no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: ANI Pharmaceuticals is a commercial-stage specialty/generics + rare-disease company. Marketed products include Cortrophin Gel (ACTH), ILUVIEN, YUTIQ (acquired via Alimera 2024), Arimidex, vancomycin oral solution, etc. No internally-sponsored Phase 1/2/3 clinical development programs were identified in the latest 10-K, on the corporate website, or as a lead sponsor on ClinicalTrials.gov. The single active study (NCT05486468, YUTIQ uveitis label-expansion P3) is investigator-initiated by Texas Retina Associates with ANI as collaborator — listed under excluded_partner_owned.
